newsitem.title: JAPAN: Catena to buy Software Japan business rights-paper.
newsitem.headline: Catena to buy Software Japan business rights-paper.

text.p: Catena Corp, a wholesaler and retailer of personal computers, will buy most of the business rights of software distributor Software Japan, a Japanese business daily said on Friday.
The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said Catena scrapped its previous plan to support Software Japan after finding out that Software Japan's business was worse than it initially thought.
Catena said in September that it would extend financial assistance to Software Japan and might consider a merger with the firm in the future.
The paper said Software Japan's debts were estimated at about 16 billion yen.
The purchase of Software Japan's business rights is expected to push up the Catena group's market share in the Japanese software wholesale market to between 30 and 40 percent, the paper said.
Officials at the two companies were not immediately available for comment.
